# AquaTwin shared project guidance

Before changing this repository, read the root [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and the complete [AI handoff](../docs/AI_HANDOFF.md). They describe the current React/FastAPI/PostgreSQL implementation, data contracts, scientific limits, tests and ordered next milestones.

Use that shared plan rather than inventing a separate architecture or treating planned features as implemented. Follow the user's explicit current request; preserve existing work and record decisions and real verification results as described in the handoff.

Before editing in every development session, including resumed work, automatically follow [../docs/SESSION_START.md](../docs/SESSION_START.md). Preserve local work; verify current origin/main before development.
